Future<void> run(groups, read) async {
 for (final batch in groups) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait(batch.map((item) async { final row = await read(item); return await save(row); }));
 }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
 for (final batch in groups) await Future.wait([for (final item in batch) read(item)]);
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
 for (final batch in groups) { await [for (final item in batch) read(item)].wait; }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
 for (final batch in groups) { await (Future.wait(batch.map(read)), Future.wait(batch.map(save))).wait; }
 for (final batch in groups) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await prepare(batch);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait(batch.map((item) async => await read(item)));
 }
 for (final batch in groups) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait(other.map((item) async => await read(item)));
 }
 for (final item in items) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait([read(item), notify(item)]);
 }
}
